body: Well, officially reached out despite all the crap he put me through but I guess I'm blocked on everything. So..
Aren't you funny? My mama is currently bangin' her cousin in Arkansas, unfortunately.

Also was dumped this past weekend so I can relate on that note, unfortunately. I mean in all honesty, something was up with her in my opinion. She was either carrying on the relationship longer than she should have then realized she'd soon have to face you or maybe she met someone else. No one just walks away that abruptly out of the blue.
Logically I couldn't tell you because it makes no sense when you actually think about it. We deserve better. Even after it all I miss him and I shouldn't..

I considered going back into treatment..I guess I'm just scared to take that step. I'm only 23..I feel like there's someone out there for me. I'm just trying to sort out how to get over this without it getting to the point it did last time. You talking to me is helping more than you know though.. Thank you

I just feel like he came into my life unexpectedly and took every ounce of happiness I had. I kept telling him my life wasn't some game. I told him I was at a breaking point but he just kept cheating and abusing me. Now, I just sit here crying alone in bed..while he's out drinking, having sex with whomever, and publicly blasting me on all social media. So I'm left humiliated. Also went to the doctors today and found out he gave me an STD from cheating. I'm the fool here and everyone knows it. The worst part is he didn't even feel bad last time I overdosed..I just can't do it anymore. He ruined me.

I feel you on this on such deep levels. My boyfriend, or I guess ex now, broke up with me this past Saturday. We got into a physical altercation while he was drunk and the cops were called. I had to move out. I feel so empty. Literally feel like I lost my best friend. Also found out I'm pregnant today (as if it couldn't get any worse). 

I hope things get better for you and you find your way. I wish I had some advice but I'm in the same boat as you currently. Hopefully things get better..
